pattern.kidney_deficiency.Chief pattern cue / 主辨證線索: Ovulatory-factor documentation context with delayed, long, scanty, irregular, or absent cycles plus Kidney signs: low back/knee soreness, fatigue, dizziness/tinnitus, low libido, or reproductive/Essence deficiency context. 排卵因素不孕背景中，若見月經後期、週期長、量少、閉經或不規則，合併腰膝酸軟、疲倦、頭暈耳鳴、性功能/生殖力低下，偏腎虛。
pattern.kidney_deficiency.Tongue / 舌: Kidney Yang/Qi deficiency: pale, swollen, wet coat. Kidney Yin/Essence deficiency: red or scant/peeled coat. 腎陽/腎氣虛多舌淡胖、苔潤；腎陰/精虧多舌紅少苔或剝苔。
pattern.kidney_deficiency.Pulse / 脈: Deep and weak as the broad Kidney deficiency cue; deep-slow-weak for Yang deficiency, thin-rapid for Yin deficiency. 腎虛總以沉弱為主；陽虛偏沉遲無力，陰虛偏細數。
pattern.kidney_deficiency.Key accompanying signs / 兼症: Ovulation-tracking notes may show inconsistent or absent LH/BBT/progesterone evidence, but the TCM discriminator is the deficiency base: delayed cycles, low back soreness, low vitality, cold signs, or deficiency-heat signs. 排卵追蹤可見 LH、基礎體溫或黃體期 progesterone 線索不穩或缺如；中醫鑑別重點是虛象底色：月經後期、腰痠、精力低、寒象或虛熱象。
pattern.kidney_deficiency.Treatment principle / 治法: Tonify Kidney, support Essence, regulate Chong/Ren and menstrual rhythm; warm Yang or nourish Yin according to signs. 補腎益精、調衝任與月經節律；依證分溫腎陽或滋腎陰。
pattern.kidney_deficiency.Representative formula / 代表方: Study anchors: formula.liu_wei_di_huang_wan, formula.jin_gui_shen_qi_wan, formula.zuo_gui_wan, formula.you_gui_wan. 學習錨點：六味地黃丸、金匱腎氣丸、左歸丸、右歸丸。

pattern.liver_qi_stagnation.Chief pattern cue / 主辨證線索: Ovulatory-factor context with irregular cycles that fluctuate with stress, emotional constraint, PMS, breast distension, hypochondriac or lower abdominal distension, sighing, mood depression, or irritability. 排卵因素背景中，若週期隨壓力波動，合併情志鬱結、PMS、乳脹、脅肋或少腹脹、善太息、鬱悶易怒，偏肝氣鬱結。
pattern.liver_qi_stagnation.Tongue / 舌: Often normal to slightly dusky with thin white coat; red edges or thin yellow coat if constraint transforms into heat. 舌可正常或偏暗，苔薄白；鬱久化熱可見邊紅或薄黃苔。
pattern.liver_qi_stagnation.Pulse / 脈: Wiry; wiry-rapid if heat signs, wiry-choppy if stasis begins to appear. 脈弦；化熱偏弦數，夾瘀或久鬱入絡偏弦澀。
pattern.liver_qi_stagnation.Key accompanying signs / 兼症: Distending discomfort rather than fixed stabbing pain; mood/cycle linkage; breast distension, PMS, headaches, throat constraint, or Liver-Spleen digestive upset may coexist. 不適偏脹而非固定刺痛；情緒與週期連動；可伴乳脹、PMS、頭痛、咽中梗阻感，或肝脾不調消化症狀。
pattern.liver_qi_stagnation.Treatment principle / 治法: Soothe Liver, move qi, regulate menstruation and Chong/Ren; clear heat only when heat signs are present. 疏肝理氣、調經與衝任；有熱象時才兼清熱。
pattern.liver_qi_stagnation.Representative formula / 代表方: Study anchors: formula.xiao_yao_san, formula.jia_wei_xiao_yao_san, formula.chai_hu_shu_gan_san. 學習錨點：逍遙散、加味逍遙散、柴胡疏肝散。

pattern.phlegm_damp.Chief pattern cue / 主辨證線索: Ovulatory-factor context with irregular or absent cycles plus damp-phlegm signs: heaviness, weight/metabolic documentation context, chest oppression or nausea, poor appetite, loose stools, leukorrhea, or a greasy coat. 排卵因素背景中，若週期不規則或閉經，合併痰濕線索：身重、代謝/體重脈絡、胸悶泛惡、納差便溏、帶下或苔膩，偏痰濕。
pattern.phlegm_damp.Tongue / 舌: Pale, swollen, or enlarged tongue, often with white greasy coat; yellow greasy coat if damp-heat signs are also present. 舌淡胖或腫大，苔白膩；若夾濕熱可見黃膩苔。
pattern.phlegm_damp.Pulse / 脈: Slippery or soggy/slippery. 脈滑，或濡滑。
pattern.phlegm_damp.Key accompanying signs / 兼症: Fatigue with body heaviness, abdominal fullness, phlegm/damp sensation, difficult weight loss, insulin-resistance documentation context, or Spleen Qi deficiency overlap. 疲倦身重、腹脹、痰濕感、體重不易降、胰島素阻抗記錄脈絡，或與脾氣虛相互重疊。
pattern.phlegm_damp.Treatment principle / 治法: Strengthen Spleen, transform dampness, resolve phlegm, regulate Chong/Ren and menstrual rhythm. 健脾化濕、祛痰，調衝任與月經節律。
pattern.phlegm_damp.Representative formula / 代表方: Study anchors: formula.er_chen_tang, formula.liu_jun_zi_tang, formula.wen_dan_tang when phlegm-heat or Gallbladder phlegm disturbance cues are present. 學習錨點：二陳湯、六君子湯；若見痰熱或膽鬱痰擾線索，可比較溫膽湯。
